hook: *9* of a family hospitalised after hotel biryani in Amberpet
hook_b: *9* of a family hospitalised after hotel biryani in Amberpet
tldr: Nine members of a family, including four children, fell ill after eating biryani ordered from a hotel in Amberpet and were taken to the Government Fever Hospital, Nallakunta. Food poisoning is suspected.

beats.what: Nine family members were rushed to the Fever Hospital, Nallakunta, after eating hotel biryani.
beats.why: Food poisoning is suspected; police alerted the Food Safety Department.
beats.care: Food safety teams will investigate; the patients' condition and details of the food are awaited.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 19, 11:57 am): the hotel has not been named in the report.

cards.q: Do you check a restaurant's hygiene before ordering online?

qs: Should food-poisoning cases trigger automatic public inspection reports?

facts.t: On Nov 18, TG SAFE suspended *4* Hyderabad eateries' FSSAI licences after raids on 10.

viz.verdict: Four of the nine are children

watch: The Food Safety Department's findings on the hotel and the food served.
